snippet.title: Blood Lily Ghoststories, a Horror Game about a Needy Female Ghost, Opening
snippet.description:
Steam store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2367120/
X: https://x.com/i_khaos
Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/SoundingStoneIndieGame

A horror game about a needy female ghost. A trio of close-knit occult club girls gather late at night to enjoy telling ghost stories. Little do they know that Miss Choker, a ghost that targets girls, is just dying to appear...
